issues.title: Root-level deprecated files should be removed
issues.description: Old root-level files (analyser.go, watcher.go, config.go, validator.go, lock.go, status.go, log.go) still exist alongside new package versions in analyzer/, cmd/, internal/. These are deprecated and should be removed. Keep only main.go at root level.

issues.title: --mcp-with-watcher not implemented but documented in spec
issues.description: Spec mentions --mcp-with-watcher flag that runs MCP server alongside watcher, but this is NOT implemented in code. Currently watch and mcp are separate commands that must run in different terminals. Either implement the feature or update spec to reflect current design.

issues.title: LineBuffer timeout should be configurable
issues.description: LineBuffer timeout is hardcoded to 500ms in analyzer/analyser.go. Should be configurable via config.yaml (e.g., output.line_buffer_timeout_ms) for different use cases and environments.

issues.title: Future Belongs to Future - periodic index rebuild
issues.description: AI context accumulates stale info over long sessions. Need mechanism for periodic full index rebuild with fresh AI sessions to maintain accuracy. Planned approach: dual-index rotation (blue-green style), configurable rebuild interval, randomized file order for diversity.

issues.title: Batch size not configurable
issues.description: File batch size for analysis is hardcoded (maxFilesPerBatch). Large projects may benefit from different batch sizes. Should add agent.batch_size config option.

issues.title: Validation retry count not configurable
issues.description: JSON schema validation retries are hardcoded to 5 (maxRetries). May want to adjust for different models or reliability requirements. Should add agent.max_retries config option.

issues.title: Cobra CLI over flag package
issues.description: Migrated from Go flag package to spf13/cobra for CLI. Enables explicit subcommands (watch/scan/mcp), better help text, auto-generated completion, and standard UX. Cobra is industry standard for Go CLIs.

issues.title: Package structure: cmd/analyzer/mcp/internal
issues.description: Refactored from flat main package to 4-package structure for better modularity and testability. Separation of concerns: CLI (cmd), core logic (analyzer), protocol (mcp), shared utils (internal).

issues.title: HistoryLogger moved to internal package for sharing
issues.description: Moved HistoryLogger to internal/ to be shared between watcher and MCP server. Both need logging to .memo/.history for debugging. Avoids code duplication and ensures consistent log format.

issues.title: Semaphore for concurrent analysis guard
issues.description: Added sem chan struct{} (capacity-1) to Watcher to prevent overlapping analyses. Debounce timer could fire while previous analysis still running. Semaphore with non-blocking acquire ensures sequential execution without blocking timer callbacks.

issues.title: Local MCP config prevents infinite recursion
issues.description: The analyser uses .memo/mcp.json instead of global ~/.kimi/mcp.json to prevent infinite recursion when memo is configured as an MCP server in the user's global config. Created automatically by initIndex().

issues.title: Deterministic session ID from workDir hash
issues.description: Each memo analysis uses a deterministic session ID format 'memo-<workdir-hash>' derived from SHA256 of the working directory path. Benefits: single session per project (reuse context), easy identification via prefix, same project always uses same ID.
